text: Executable references for I-VT and I-DT are pymovements v0.26.2 at commit 6753fdf8b81da40b890576dd6b369edb81243b06, paths src/pymovements/events/detection/ivt.py and idt.py, MIT. The publication remains the canonical definition; conformance must report eyes4s's typed deviations such as central position-derived velocity, half-open intervals, and per-axis I-DT extent rather than hiding them.
